title: Doom’s Winter Dominion
description: A Marvel holiday CTF in snowbound Latveria: 25 character appearances, seventeen distinct maps, Doombots, hidden gifts, and an optional 15-challenge rescue of the Holiday Star.

nodes.text: Happy holidays! Doom has commandeered the Holiday Star. This is our chance to get it back without ruining the party.

Winter Guard Captain is at (25,19). Ask what to investigate, then examine the winter signal at (18,20). Glowing transport tiles connect the square to the six rooms; return to a room’s arrival tile to come back.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
Doom has locked the sleigh network. We need clear evidence, careful teamwork, and a plan.

Begin at the signal marker in this square. Follow the files through the Gift Foundry and Sleigh Relay. A red key opens the Aurora Reactor Vault; the vault’s gold key opens Castle Doom. All flags use FLAG{...}.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
I brought emergency acorns. Doom brought emergency legislation. Mine will be more useful.
There is an acorn audit at (23,17). A second rumor says a gift is buried at the square’s exact tile (15,21). Stand there and Search; try a friendly wave if you find anything.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
The sleigh receiver still works. Doom merely made the messages unnecessarily theatrical.
Read the dispatch headers, then reverse the mirrored message. These are static practice files: no external target, scanning, or live exploitation is required.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
The storm has delayed the sleigh. It shall not delay our investigation.
A route hidden in a response header tells us where the sleigh should go. Read the whole file before guessing.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
SEASONAL GREETING. PARCEL INTEGRITY IS A MATTER OF IMPERIAL PRIDE.
The gift terminal uses Base64. The parcel sentry’s diagnostic uses binary ASCII. Decode them carefully; one earns a red vault key.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.

emojiInteractions.response: POSITIVE FEEDBACK RECEIVED. GIFT-WRAPPING MORALE INCREASED.

nodes.text: There is a warm cup waiting for every tired gift-maker. Let us get this loading dock moving again.
Base64 often ends in one or two equals signs. A free hint explains how to decode the gift terminal without needing a live website.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
My wooden gears can move a mountain of presents. You handle the tiny numbers on the labels.
Eight binary digits describe one ASCII character. Put the characters together in the order printed by the sentry.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
Seven snowglobes. Seven possibilities. Doom chose the one with the worst holiday music.
A Caesar shift replaces letters by a fixed number of positions. Undo a shift of three to recover the snowglobe’s message.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
The ornaments remember every message, including the ones Doom tried to disguise.
Percent escapes such as %7B represent characters in a URL. Decode the ornament inscription once; leave the flag’s punctuation intact.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
I catalog every snowglobe in this library. The invisible gift, however, keeps disappearing from the catalog.
A hidden gift in the square has a secret greeting. Discover it and wave to reveal the Secret Santa challenge here. The hidden item is found only from its exact anchor tile.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
Doom wired the reactor into the holiday lights. Excessive? Yes. A troubleshooting opportunity? Also yes.
Convert the power display from binary to decimal. The gold key it releases opens the northern throne route in Doomstadt.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
The vault watches for impatience. Slow down and read the color values.
In #RRGGBB, the first pair is red, the second green, and the third blue. The sentinel’s strongest channel names the flag.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
There you are! The cocoa is still warm, and the Holiday Star is waiting for the signal.
After the throne puzzle, restore the sleigh’s final dispatch here. Then write a brief team debrief. Keep any real assessment answers separate from these public practice flags.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.

emojiInteractions.response: A little kindness is the brightest signal of all. Happy holidays!

nodes.text: A ribbon rustles beneath your boots. You found a gift with no visible wrapping. The tag asks for a friendly wave.
The tag unfolds: FLAG{SECRET_SANTA}. A Secret Santa marker is now available in the Snowglobe Sanctum at (12,18).

emojiInteractions.response: The invisible tag reads FLAG{SECRET_SANTA}. Search the newly revealed Secret Santa marker in Snowglobe Sanctum at (12,18).

nodes.text: Stormbreaker is ready. The paperwork, I am told, must be handled more delicately.
The main hallway goes left and right. Follow the upper central passage to the orbital lift. Side rooms contain desks and records you can use for new challenges.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
Nice filing system. I could automate it, but Doom keeps rejecting my equipment budget.
Walk through the open doorways into each office. The desks are solid, so go around them rather than through them.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
The castle is quiet tonight. That makes the footsteps in the next gallery easier to hear.
The east-west gallery connects the study and armory. Lower passages lead to the treasury and feast chamber; the northern hall opens into the antechamber.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
A station among the stars! A worthy place for a holiday feast, once we clear these gift crates.
A central junction connects the bridge, observation room, cargo bay, and reactor room. Follow the illuminated corridors and open airlocks.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
Even among the stars, a small act of kindness can illuminate a world.
The northern central airlock reaches Castle Doom’s secret galleries. Return to the station’s arrival doorway to go back to the office wing.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
Doom invited me to decorate. Apparently he meant ribbons, and absolutely nothing that flies.
The walls are real, even when my directions are questionable. Follow the lit floor through an open doorway to enter a side room.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
I came to bargain for a quieter holiday. Doom offered me reactor maintenance.
This lower chamber is reached through a short corridor from the main junction. Return the same way; the outer hull is not a shortcut.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
SEASONAL INVENTORY: COMPLETE. HUMAN PAPERWORK: STILL INEFFICIENT.
The cargo bay connects to the central corridor through its upper doorway. Solid consoles and bulkheads cannot be stepped through.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
Four mechanical arms, and I am still expected to sort the gift forms alphabetically.
The lower-left workroom opens onto the main hallway. The reception entrance is down the central passage; the space lift is at the north end.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
I memorized every move in the holiday training drill. Nobody warned me about the budget meeting.
This conference room is a real room, not an illusion. Use its open upper doorway to reach the hallway and the other offices.
Work together, keep notes, and verify what you find. Search near a challenge marker to open it. Emoji reactions are always available, even when a character has no secret reply.
